_note: UDF KPI card library, kit copy (study 2026-11-15). Optional toolbelt: used only when the plan or the person picks a function. Permission and sources: design/udf/udf-kpi-library-provenance.md. Changes from the author's originals: CHANGES.md. Colours and fonts are {{token}} placeholders filled by `pbik udf render`; `pbik udf check` checks fingerprints and model tables first.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Card1
functions.description: KPI card image with a progress bar of the change (capped at 100%), label, value in thousands with a $ prefix. Style: trailing font and colour parameters; pass BLANK() for the report's design tokens.
functions.example: Park.SVG.Card1 ( [Sales], [Sales PY], "Sales", "", "#038D96", BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK() )
functions.useWhen: the change itself is the story (a bar from -100% to +100%)
functions.avoidWhen: the value isn't money (the $ and K are fixed inside)

functions.name: Park.SVG.Card2
functions.description: KPI card image: label, big value, change pill against the comparison, icon tile, accent bar on the left. Style: trailing font and colour parameters; pass BLANK() for the report's design tokens.
functions.example: Park.SVG.Card2 ( [Sales], [Sales PY], "Sales", "", "#038D96", BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK() )
functions.useWhen: one headline number with its change, on a designed card; the card the source report uses
functions.avoidWhen: a native new card with a reference label shows the same thing (ladder step 1)

functions.name: Park.SVG.SVGKPICard
functions.description: KPI card image with value, change, icon and a small chart over the months; picks one of 13 chart styles by name (Line1-3, Bar1-5, Dumbbell1-5). Style: trailing colour parameters (and its own font); BLANK() gives the report's design tokens.
functions.example: Park.SVG.SVGKPICard ( "Sales", [Sales], [Sales PY], 'Date'[Month Number], 'Date'[Month], "", "#026E75", "#A84545", "#5D6B8A", BLANK(), BLANK(), "Bar5", BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK() )
functions.useWhen: a KPI needs its trend in the same tile
functions.avoidWhen: the date has no month order and label columns (an unknown style name now stops with an error)

functions.name: Park.SVG.SVGKPICardGradient
functions.description: Like SVGKPICard with three accent colours and its own six chart styles (Dumbbell1, Dumbbell2, Dumbbell2c, Dumbbell3, Bar1, Area1). Fixed in the kit copy (K-04). Style: trailing font and colour parameters; pass BLANK() for the report's design tokens.

requires.why: SUMMARIZE('Date', <order>, <label>): the order and label columns passed in must be in 'Date'

functions.example: Park.SVG.SVGKPICardGradient ( "Sales", [Sales], [Sales PY], 'Date'[Month Number], 'Date'[Month], "", "#038D96", "#A84545", "#5D6B8A", "Bar1", BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK(), BLANK() )
functions.useWhen: a microchart card needs three accent colours
functions.avoidWhen: SVGKPICard's 13 styles cover it; Dumbbell2c needs a table called 'Date'

functions.name: Park.SVG.BasicLineChart
functions.description: Stand-alone line chart image over the months with max and min points marked.

requires.why: SUMMARIZE('Date', <order>, <label>): the order and label columns passed in must be in 'Date'

functions.useWhen: a trend image in a table row or card
functions.avoidWhen: a native line chart or sparkline can show it; the date table isn't called 'Date' (it is read by name)

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.BarLineV_RB
functions.description: Current columns with a comparison benchmark line and a red dot where it falls short (style Bar5; the source report's card).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.BarPast_LineCurrent
functions.description: Comparison as columns, current as a line (style Bar2).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.BarinBarColor
functions.description: Comparison columns with current columns inside, coloured up or down (style Bar3). The card passes its colours in a different order from the parameter list.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.BarwithTarget
functions.description: Current columns with the comparison as a target tick per month (style Bar4).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.BasicLineChart
functions.description: Line of the current measure with max and min points (style Line1).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.ColumnWithColor
functions.description: Columns of the current measure, coloured up or down against the comparison (style Bar1).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.DumbbellHorizontal
functions.description: Horizontal dumbbell per month (style Dumbbell3).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.DumbbellSolid
functions.description: Vertical dumbbell, solid rounded stroke with end caps (style Dumbbell5).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.DumbbellSolidRounded
functions.description: Vertical dumbbell as one thick rounded stroke per month (style Dumbbell2).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.DumbbellSolidRoundedColor
functions.description: Dumbbell with the older 12-argument signature (size, padding, ticks passed in); used by the gradient card's Dumbbell2c style; reads 'Date' by name.

requires.why: SUMMARIZE('Date', <order>, <label>): the order and label columns passed in must be in 'Date'

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.DumbbellV_RB_FixedDots
functions.description: Vertical dumbbell per month: current and comparison dots joined by a thin line coloured up or down (style Dumbbell1).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.DumbbellV_RB_FixedDots2
functions.description: Vertical dumbbell with a thick rounded connector and two dots (style Dumbbell4).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.Line2
functions.description: Two lines: current and comparison, with axis labels (style Line2).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Micro.LineAreaV_PastCurrent
functions.description: Comparison as a filled area, current as a line, latest value labelled (style Line3).

functions.name: Park.Icons.GradientIcon
functions.description: An icon from the icons table filled with a two-colour gradient.

requires.why: looks up the icon by name (LOOKUPVALUE icons[Content], icons[Name])

functions.useWhen: a decorative icon with a gradient
functions.avoidWhen: the model has no icons table; two gradient icons in one image (the gradient id is fixed)
functions.status: disabled: the icon pack's licence isn't confirmed (its site wasn't named; the icon names look like Remix Icon, whose Remix Icon License v1.0 isn't MIT, Apache or CC0). Name the source and its licence in design/udf/udf-kpi-library-provenance.md to enable

functions.name: Park.Icons.SolidIcon
functions.description: An icon from the model's icons table, recoloured in one colour, as an SVG image.

requires.why: looks up the icon by name (LOOKUPVALUE icons[Content], icons[Name])

functions.useWhen: a card or table needs a small icon in a token colour
functions.avoidWhen: the model has no icons table (Name, Content)
functions.status: disabled: the icon pack's licence isn't confirmed (its site wasn't named; the icon names look like Remix Icon, whose Remix Icon License v1.0 isn't MIT, Apache or CC0). Name the source and its licence in design/udf/udf-kpi-library-provenance.md to enable

functions.name: Park.SVG.Calc.PercentDeltaPct
functions.description: Change from comparison to current as a percent number (0 when the comparison is 0 or blank).
functions.useWhen: a change percent inside SVG code
functions.avoidWhen: a model measure already gives it (use that, so the numbers audit sees one source)

functions.name: Park.SVG.Fmt.AbbrevKMB
functions.description: Number as short text: 950, 1.2K, 3.4M, 5.6bn, 7.8T.
functions.avoidWhen: the number needs a currency or unit (none is added)

functions.name: Park.SVG.Fmt.PercentWithSign
functions.description: Percent text with + or - and 0-3 decimals.
functions.avoidWhen: a format string on a measure can do it

functions.name: Park.Icons.CleanSVG
functions.description: Removes currentColor and none fills from raw icon SVG so it can be recoloured.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Aux.NiceStep
functions.description: A tidy tick step (1, 2 or 5 x 10^n) for a range and a wanted tick count.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Aux.ScaleX
functions.description: Maps a value to an x pixel with left and right padding.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Aux.ScaleY
functions.description: Maps a value to a y pixel (SVG y grows downwards).

functions.name: Park.SVG.Frag.XLabels_Vertical_ByNumText
functions.description: SVG text for the month labels along the x axis, shortened to fit.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Frag.YLabels_FromRange
functions.description: SVG text for the y-axis tick labels.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Tab.Base_ByNumText
functions.description: Table of current and comparison values per date key and label (blank becomes 0). Every microchart starts here.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Tab.Geo_Vertical_ByNumText
functions.description: Adds pixel positions (x, y for current and comparison, baseline) to the base table.

functions.name: Park.SVG.Tab.YTicks
functions.description: Table of y-axis tick values, positions and short labels.
